dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete, senior‑engineer level details (worker‑type → executor mapping, specific CloudWatch metric name, exact CLI probes, 15‑layer decision tree). However, ~4 points are deducted because much of the content restates publicly documented Glue behaviour that a capable model could already generate (e.g., "G.2X doubles executor count", generic OOM reasoning).

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes an AWS‑specific diagnostic workflow: pre‑flight gather, read‑only probes, ordered layer traversal, and mandatory CONFIRM before any state‑changing CLI. One point deducted because some procedures (e.g., "check CloudWatch Logs") are generic and not uniquely Glue‑specific.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a detailed NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., never declare ROOT_CAUSE without a failing probe, never run Spark on G.025X). One point deducted because a couple of warnings lack explicit failure‑mode examples (e.g., the rule about "never assume bookmark is enabled" could cite a concrete schema‑change scenario).

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter is complete, description clearly states WHAT it does, WHEN to invoke, and includes a rich keyword list, activation triggers, invocation schema, and example. No missing fields.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level Quick‑Start gives a concise entry point, and deeper sections are layered. However, the skill front‑loads a large amount of detail (full philosophy, extensive tables) before the core diagnostic steps, which can cause cognitive overload and hides some critical rules (e.g., the CONFIRM gate) deep in the document.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated behind explicit CONFIRM prompts; read‑only probes are the default. The level of specificity matches the fragility of Glue job configuration changes.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a coherent pattern (Mindset → Philosophy → Quick reference → Pre‑flight → Stepwise Process → Output format → Anti‑patterns), matching established skill templates.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides a usable decision tree, concrete CLI commands, and output format, enabling an agent to act. Two points deducted because some commands (e.g., the CloudWatch metric "glue.executor.memory.maxUsed") are not guaranteed to exist, and edge‑case handling (missing security‑group IDs, ambiguous error messages) is not fully covered.
